metadata.case_name: AZHAR HUSSAIN v. FASTCUT SERVICES LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: general worker assisting the operation of the drilling machine (employee of the 1st Defendant)

injuries.description: injury in his right ankle with residual stiffness and mild residual decrease of endurance
source: injury he suffered in his right ankle with its residual stiffness and mild residual decrease of endurance
mild residual stiffness in the right ankle, likely to be in the form of a mild decrease in his endurance with unduly prolonged squatting and with period of excessive heavy object lifting

there “may be a very mild reduction in his capacity as related to the mild residual stiffness in the right ankle. This would likely be in the form of a mild decrease in his endurance with unduly prolonged staying in squatting, and when prolonged period of excessive heavy object lifting is required.”
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of ankle, unspecified

manifestations.description: He had difficulty squatting beyond one minute.
He had difficulty carrying weights and in particular walking when carrying weights.
He had difficulty walking more than 3 to 4 flights of stairs.
A mild decrease in his endurance with unduly prolonged squatting.

losses.description: Reduced ability to squat for prolonged periods, reduced ability to carry weights and to walk multiple flights of stairs; difficulty with slopes.

Reduced competitiveness in the job market and loss of earning capacity; assessed reduction in ability to obtain work similar to pre-accident employment leading to an award for loss of earning capacity.
